visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A mother with long brown hair wearing white wireless earbuds and a young girl in a white t-shirt are riding a yellow mechanical horse on a metal rail. They are both laughing joyfully with wide smiles; the girl's mouth is open in excitement. The setting is a lush outdoor park with dense green trees and foliage under bright, overcast daylight. (2) A boy's hands are shown gripping a black air gun, aiming and shooting at a large, brown-scaled animatronic dinosaur that has its mouth open to reveal sharp teeth. The dinosaur is situated in a wooded area on a bed of mulch and dry leaves, surrounded by a metal fence and greenery. (3) The camera switches to a POV shot from a red mechanical horse ride moving along a silver track through the park. A boy in a white t-shirt is then seen holding the red handles of the horse, looking forward. The background consists of manicured green lawns, stone paths, and a white gazebo. (4) Inside a dark 'scary tunnel' attraction, purple and green neon lights illuminate grotesque monster sculptures, including a large clawed limb and a witch-like figure with a long nose. The environment is dim and filled with theatrical props, creating a high-contrast and eerie atmosphere. (5) Several families are seen driving yellow and black go-karts on a paved outdoor track. A boy in a white t-shirt steers his kart, followed by a woman and a young girl in another. The setting is a paved loop bordered by trees and a white canopy under natural daylight. (6) Adults and children are sliding down a steep green artificial grass slope on red and blue plastic sleds. A man in a black t-shirt pulls a blue sled back up the hill while a little girl follows him. The background is an open grassy area with distant trees. (7) The final phase shows an indoor play area with a green and yellow checkered foam mat floor. Children are sitting on the floor playing with colorful plastic building blocks, while adults sit on light green sofas in the background. The room is brightly lit with large windows showing the park greenery.
